title: cicd-canary-rollback-breadcrumbs-notes
content:
Context:
- Quick personal scratchpad for the canary failure observed in infra-release-2025-02-11. Capturing commands tried, errors, hypotheses and the rollback steps we executed (and what I still want to validate).

Timeline (high level):
- 2025-02-11 03:10 UTC: Canary rollout started for artifact platform:v2025.02.11-7a2d
- 2025-02-11 03:28 UTC: First error spikes in canary (increased 5xx rate for route /v1/generate).
- 2025-02-11 03:35 UTC: Automated canary abort triggered; traffic shifted back to stable (platform:v2025.01.29-bc9f).
- 2025-02-11 04:00 UTC: Repro and local investigation started.

Facts observed (logs / metrics snippets):
- Example error from canary task logs:
  2025-02-11T03:26:19Z ERROR runtime/handler.go:144 request_id=8a3f
  token_stream: runtime panic: kvcache index out of range
  goroutine 52 [running]:

- Canary metrics:
  - p95 latency +40% vs stable (stable ~86ms, canary ~120ms)
  - 5xx rate jumped from 0.3% -> 6.7% during t=03:24-03:30
  - Error tag breakdown: 72% kvcache-index, 15% OOM fragments, rest misc timeouts

- Artifact info:
  - platform:v2025.02.11-7a2d (build id: 7a2d) — includes runtime bump 1.21.0 -> 1.22.0 and new kvcache rewrite (PR #1824)
  - stable: platform:v2025.01.29-bc9f (build id: bc9f)

Commands I ran (local/devbox):
- Pull canary image to dev and run smoke:
  docker pull ghcr.io/redwood-inference/platform:7a2d
  docker run --rm -e LOG_LEVEL=debug ghcr.io/redwood-inference/platform:7a2d ./start-local.sh

- Reproduced a subset of error locally by hitting seq length 4096 prompt stream:
  curl -s -X POST http://localhost:8080/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"<4096 tokens>"}' | jq .error
  -> returned: {"message":"kvcache index out of range", "code":500}

- Grepped for kvcache changes in PR:
  git fetch origin pull/1824/head:pr-1824
  git checkout pr-1824
  git diff --stat origin/main..pr-1824 | grep kvcache

- Reproduced specific failing unit test locally:
  go test ./runtime -run TestKVCacheIndexEdgeCase -v
  -> failed with panic matching canary logs

Immediate rollback steps (what we executed):
- Triggered quick rollback via release tooling:
  ./tools/release rollback --cluster=canary --to platform:v2025.01.29-bc9f --reason "canary 5xx spike kvcache index"
- Confirmed canary tasks replaced; smoke-checked endpoints and saw 5xx drop back to baseline within 6m.
- Opened incident ticket RINF-4321 and added initial notes + links to logs and PR 1824.

Hypotheses (ranked):
1) KV cache rewrite introduced an indexing bug for long-sequence KV layouts (most likely): reproduces locally on TestKVCacheIndexEdgeCase and under long seqs.
2) Interplay between runtime 1.22.0 and a small allocator change: the new kernel forces different memory layout causing some off-by-one in kv entry pointer arithmetic.
3) Resource pressure (IOPS/ephemeral disk) triggered OOMs and then corrupted cache index: less likely given reproducible unit test.

Notes on artifact versioning / provenance to confirm:
- Build metadata for 7a2d: GH Actions run #45678, docker digest sha256:abc123... (need to confirm full digest).
- Linked PRs: PR #1824 (kvcache rewrite) + PR #1809 (runtime bump). They were merged together into release branch release/2025-02-11.
- Need to check if the canary image was incorrectly built with an intermediate commit (rare but seen before when CI retries).
  Command to check image labels:
  docker inspect --format='{{index .Config.Labels "git-commit"}}' ghcr.io/redwood-inference/platform:7a2d

What I tried and outcomes:
- Re-running unit tests with race detector: go test -race ./runtime -run TestKVCacheIndexEdgeCase -> intermittent pass/fail (suggests timing-sensitive).
- Instrumented kvcache bounds checks (quick patch) and rebuilt image locally -> tests pass and local reproduce returns error but with bounds-check log that identifies index=-1 case.
- Deployed patched image to isolated canary host (single instance) and exercised seq-length scenarios: no 5xx after patch for 2h.

Open questions / To-do (next actions):
- Recreate a CI reproducible build pipeline run that produced 7a2d and verify no artifact corruption (check full docker digest vs GH release tag).
- Add more unit tests targeting negative index scenarios and long-sequence KV layouts.
- Work with runtime/infra to add ephemeral bounds checks behind a feature flag (lightweight, to exercise in canary before rolling out).
- Postmortem section to fill: timeline, root cause, remediation, and action items (assign owners).

Rollback procedure notes (for runbook):
- Preferred quick rollback: ./tools/release rollback --cluster=canary --to <stable-tag> --reason <brief>
- If rollback fails to restore stable tasks: escalate to SRE: kubectl rollout undo deployment/platform --namespace=canary ; if pods stuck, kubectl delete pod --grace-period=0 --force <pod>
- Validate post-rollback: check 5xx < 1% for 10m and p95 latency within 20% of baseline.

Breadcrumbs for follow-up (notes to self):
- Capture full failing core dump (if available) from canary node: /var/log/platform/core_*
- Compare binary symbols between 7a2d and local patched build to ensure correct commit compiled.
- Pair with Aisha on test-writing session tomorrow (2025-02-12) 10:00 PST.

Quick snippets for copy-paste (useful commands):
- Rollback: ./tools/release rollback --cluster=canary --to platform:v2025.01.29-bc9f --reason "canary 5xx spike kvcache index"
- Inspect image label: docker inspect --format='{{index .Config.Labels "git-commit"}}' ghcr.io/redwood-inference/platform:7a2d
- Run failing test: go test ./runtime -run TestKVCacheIndexEdgeCase -v

Unresolved blockers:
- Need CI artifacts team to confirm GH Actions run #45678 saved full docker digest and attached to release tag (pinged @build-systems).
- If the problem is timing-sensitive, need a reproducible stress harness for longer-run tests (I have a proto harness under tools/stress/kvcache-stress, needs polish).

End-note: This is messy; keeping it intentionally informal so I can riff during debugging. Will extract a cleaned postmortem once we confirm root cause and remediation.
